bmc timed out at 500s, but that run also had to build Prop16/Prop32 deps for the first time. Let me rerun with deps now cached and a larger timeout.

<<<RUN cwd=LeanEuclidPlus>>>
source ~/.venvs/leaneuclid/bin/activate; export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"; echo "===== bmc retry ====="; timeout 1000 lake build Book1.Prop47.bmc > /tmp/bmc2.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -iE "error|unsolved|sorry|linarith|failed" /tmp/bmc2.log | grep -vE "Prop29|Prop16/Main|Prop32/Main|Prop0|Prop1[0-9]/Main|Prop2[0-9]/Main|Prop3[0-9]/Main" | head -20; echo ALLDONE
<<<END>>>
